Net-new native-only keys (signalDiff.shareCopied/shareUnavailable, .noChangesTitle, .native.csvUnavailable, .native.alertUnavailable, .dismiss) carry English defaults for the native-only affordances.

Inlined SignalCompareControls verbatim-by-behaviour because web/src/features/telemetry/components/SignalCompareControls.tsx is NOT in the native conversion manifest — only features/telemetry/components/SignalDiffTable.tsx is converted (confirmed by globbing apps/native/src/web-parity/features/telemetry/**). This follows the precedent the LiveSignalInspectorPage port set for its non-manifest LiveSignalsTable and the AlertsListPage port for AlertCard. The inlined controls reproduce the web component exactly: the topSlot, the Window A (cyan)/Window B (amber) labelled fields each with a HelpTooltip (the already-converted native HelpTooltip, same i18nKey help.signal.snapshot/help.signal.diff + defaultValue + ariaLabel), the 5 preset Buttons (applyPreset -> preset.compute() -> toLocalDatetimeInput onChangeA/onChangeB), the filter field, the 8 category chips (active toggles to null) and the Clear Button. CATEGORY_PREFIXES + toLocalDatetimeInput + isoOrEmpty are re-exported so they stay available to a future SignalsWorkspacePage port. The web `<Input type="datetime-local">` has no native datetime picker wired in these parity ports, so each window is a TextInput taking the SAME `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` local string with a matching placeholder — atA/atB state and the isoOrEmpty(localValue) -> ISO conversion are preserved exactly (documented native-safe adaptation).

DOM/web-UI swaps — no DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, react-router, framer-motion, lucide-react, @/lib/cn, or old web UI imports: PageContainer (title/subtitle/actions) -> an inline ScrollView scaffold (persistent header + always-rendered body); usePageTitle(t('signalDiff.title')) -> the same translated string surfaced as an accessibilityRole='header' on-screen title (no document.title on native); GlassPanel -> the shared native GlassPanel; Select (vehicle picker) -> a segmented radio pill group (accessibilityRole radiogroup/radio) preserving the {value,label} options and the value=String(vehicleId||'') / onChange setVehicleIdParam(Number(value)) contract; CopyButton (Share permalink, size='sm') -> an inline ShareLinkButton using navigator.clipboard.writeText when present (react-native-web) and surfacing an explicit 'Copy unavailable' state on iOS/Android where no clipboard module is bundled — the established native CopyButton idiom; SavedViewMenu (URL-saved views) is browser-only and OMITTED, so useSavedViewUrl().apply is unused and dropped while currentQuery is synthesized from the in-memory URL-state params (vehicle/a/b/q/cat) and the permalink is built from the canonical /telemetry/signal-diff route (web reads window.location.origin+pathname, absent on native); StatCard x4 -> an inline native StatCard (label + value, isLoading-aware via the page's '—' values); BulkActionsToolbar -> the already-converted native BulkActionsToolbar (imported) with the verbatim BulkAction[] — lucide Pin/PinOff become the same filled/outline star glyphs (U+2605/U+2606) the SignalDiffTable port uses and Bell becomes SemanticIcon name='notifications'; downloadCSV (browser file download) and useNavigate('/alert-studio…') have no native analogue, so the CSV is still built via the ported RFC-4180 objectsToCSV/escapeCell and BOTH actions surface a dismissible native notice carrying the exact filename+row+byte counts / target route; Skeleton height=36 x6 -> inline SkeletonBar Views; lucide GitCompare (no-changes empty) -> SemanticIcon name='gitCompare' + the shared native EmptyState; Badge variant='neutral' -> an inline native Badge pill; FadeIn (framer-motion) -> plain Views; the Tailwind text-[var(--text-*)]/cyan-300/amber-300/rose colours -> theme tokens (textPrimary/textSecondary/textMuted/accent/warning/danger). currentQuery is built with encodeURIComponent (not URLSearchParams) to stay independent of the RN URL polyfill. Every web slot carries a testID (signal-diff-page, signal-diff-share, signal-compare-controls, signal-diff-vehicle-select, signal-diff-vehicle-option-<value|none>, signal-diff-window-a/-b, signal-diff-preset-<id>, signal-diff-filter, signal-diff-category-<id>, signal-diff-category-clear, signal-diff-table-panel, signal-diff-loading, signal-diff-empty, signal-diff-error, signal-diff-notice(+-dismiss), signal-diff-pinned).
